ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

sections.ItemName:
Large Shield
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

adventurers have traveled this way

Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.

with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way

tragedy that befell the town of

Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.

gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of

Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

Lord of Terror, walks the world again.

Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.

have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.

gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

along.

seems to be the leader of this camp.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

sections.ItemName:
Heavy Boots
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

adventurers have traveled this way

No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.

gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.

gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.

seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

along.

seems to be the leader of this camp.

adventurers have traveled this way

Lord of Terror, walks the world again.

Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.

shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.

gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc4Horadric Malus
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.

sections.ItemName:
ÿc4Key to the Cairn Stones
ÿc445
Greetings, stranger. I'm not surprised 
to see your kind here. Many 
adventurers have traveled this way 
since the recent troubles began.
 
No doubt you've heard about the 
tragedy that befell the town of 
Tristram. Some say that Diablo, the 
Lord of Terror, walks the world again.
 
I don't know if I believe that, but a Dark 
Wanderer did travel this route a few 
weeks ago. He was headed east to the 
mountain pass guarded by the Rogue 
Monastery.
 
Maybe it's nothing, but evil seems to 
have trailed in his wake. You see, 
shortly after the Wanderer went 
through, the Monastery's Gates to the 
pass were closed and strange 
creatures began ravaging the 
countryside.
 
Until it's safer outside the camp and the 
gates are re-opened, I'll remain here 
with my caravan. I hope to leave for 
Lut Gholein before the shadow that fell 
over Tristram consumes us all.  If 
you're still alive then, I'll take you 
along.
 
You should talk to Akara, too. She 
seems to be the leader of this camp. 
Maybe she can tell you more.
